subtopic: Checking Investment Professional Licenses and Backgrounds
source_evidence: Smart investors check the background of anyone promoting an investment opportunity, even before learning about the opportunity itself.
question: Misconception: If someone promoting an investment seems trustworthy, I can wait to check their background until after I research the investment. Is that a sound approach?
answer: No. Check the background of the person promoting the investment first. The source says a free search tool can help you find out whether an investment professional is licensed and registered and whether they have a disciplinary history or customer complaints.
